n2f323b72e5.headline: Zetor laid off 145 people, sales will continue to decline this year
n2f323b72e5.summary: Zetor Tractors in Brno laid off 145 employees due to economic difficulties and expects sales to continue declining this year.
n2f323b72e5.why: Zetor is a significant manufacturer in Czech Republic's industrial sector; layoffs and sales decline reflect broader manufacturing challenges.

na31ef77ae9.headline: NON-CONVENTIONAL FINANCING - More Than 6.5 Billion DA Mobilized - What Has Been Done With It…
na31ef77ae9.summary: The Algerian Treasury mobilized 6,556.2 billion DA from the Bank of Algeria for non-conventional financing between November 2017 and January 2019, injecting over half into the economy.
na31ef77ae9.why: Non-conventional financing measures by Algeria's Treasury indicate efforts to support economic activity amid fiscal challenges.
